sources: Esri World Imagery export around 46.0148,-85.0086 (pin check), read 2026-10-25
summary: No DNR page for this campground: the entry's website is the Little Brevort Lake-North page (20 sites, NW side of the lake, 2.3 mi E of Brevort via Worth and Ozark roads), and the state forest amenity table lists only Little Brevort Lake-North - no South campground (the 2026-10-20 season-dates read of the same table had none either, and the 2026-10-09 fee pass found no row for it). Nothing written; the stored derived values (23 sites, max 40 ft, vault toilets, water, FCFS, 15-day limit) rest on the note alone. The pin is ~850 m SE of the North campground on a wooded point between US-2 and the lake's south shore, a separate place with no shared entrance, but imagery shows no campground loop or pads (canopy).
flags: Possible permanent closure / not a campground: Michigan DNR has no page and no amenity-table row for a Little Brevort Lake-South State Forest Campground (the table, read 2026-10-25, lists only Little Brevort Lake-North, 20 sites). AllStays (a directory, secondary) says of 'Little Brevort Lake South SF Campground': 'Was closed but reopened in 2014 for boats only', and How's Your River lists 'Little Brevoort Lake (South)' only as a boat ramp and access site. Imagery at the pin (46.0148,-85.0086) shows forest beside US-2 with one faint track, no visible loop. Candidate for removal; a human decides.

Website belongs to a different campground: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/littlebrevort is the Little Brevort Lake-North page (shared with entry 3711). No DNR page exists for a South campground.

Not one campground with 3711: the two pins are ~850 m apart on opposite sides of the lake's south/northwest shores, North reached from Worth and Ozark roads, South from US-2; but only North is a DNR campground today.
